channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: ARCAthens: Athens Residency Fellowships (Spring 2027) (closes 14 Nov)
item.description:
ARCAthens
Deadline: 14 Nov 2026, 23:00 EST
Award: Fully funded: housing, travel, a Fellowship Prize and a weekly stipend (most recent published terms, Fall 2026: USD 3,000 Fellowship Prize and USD 200/week stipend, round-trip airfare reimbursed). No application fee.

The Athens Residency is the flagship program of ARCAthens, a not-for-profit founded in 2017, offering fully funded Fellowships for visual artists and curators to live and work in Athens.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.description:

Deadline: 16 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 6,000 grant per artist, covering remuneration, daily allowances and return travel to Aniane. Accommodation provided, plus rehearsal, recording and workshop space in the former abbey and help with local travel.

Artistic research and creation residency 'A Living Valley: A Sensitive Evocation of the Herault Valley', run by Montpellier 2028 - Terres de culture and the Communaute de communes Vallee de l'Herault as part of L'Abbaye des Possibles, a project reimagining the former Aniane Abbey as a place for...

item.title: Festival Opera Prima 2027: Call for Entries, experimental theatre and performing arts (Rovigo, Italy, 9-13 June 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Associazione Festival Opera Prima
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026
Award: Fee amount not published. Each selected company is paid an agreed fee on invoice (described in the call as a production budget that also covers travel and other meals), plus lodging at an affiliated guesthouse for the performing artists and technicians and one dinner. Festival covers organisation, staff, communication and promotion. No application fee.

23rd edition of Festival Opera Prima in Rovigo, Italy, selecting performances for 9-13 June 2027. Open to single artists and emerging or independent professional companies in contemporary theatre, dance and performing arts, from Italy and abroad, in any legal form able to handle the administration...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Futures of Listening x Immersive Audio Network: Residency Open Call (Bristol, IAN Festival 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) and the Immersive Audio Network (IAN)
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 1,750 residency fee (excl. VAT, paid on invoice), plus return travel from the Netherlands to Bristol and private accommodation for 22 to 30 January 2027. No application fee.

One residency for a freelance audio practitioner (composer, sound designer, audio maker, artist or researcher) registered in the Netherlands, to develop an existing project into a spatial, story-led sound work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: MON-ART: Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency 2027, art, sustainability and community (Cyprus, EUR 6,000 fee) (closes 23 Nov)
item.description:
Visual Voices (MON-ART project, co-funded by Creative Europe)
Deadline: 23 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 6,000 artist fee per artist, plus EUR 1,400 production costs, travel (EUR 600-1,000) and shared accommodation. Two artists selected. No application fee stated.

Visual Voices invites artists working at the intersection of art, sustainability and community life to the Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency in Nicosia, Cyprus.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: BBBank Award in Projection Mapping 2027: PLAYGROUND (ZKM, SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe) (closes 25 Nov)
item.description:
ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe, with BBBank and SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe
Deadline: 25 Nov 2026, 13:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 prize if the selected concept is realised, plus EUR 10,000 production funding covering fees and technology. No application fee.

Open call for a 7-minute projection mapping on the Karlsruhe palace facade, on the 2027 festival theme Playground (The Art of Playing). For artists, designers, studios and collectives working in projection mapping; ZKM provides curatorial and technical coaching.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy 2027: Open Call for Ephemeral In Situ Artworks (21st edition) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Sancy Tourist Office (Office de Tourisme du Sancy)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026, 09:00 CET
Award: EUR 8,000 (all taxes included) per selected artist or group: EUR 6,500 artistic costs and EUR 1,500 royalties (recommended proportion), travel costs included. 10 works commissioned. No application fee mentioned.

The 21st edition of Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy, an open-air art exhibition in the Massif du Sancy (Auvergne, France) running 19 June to 26 September 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: EHIN European Hybrid Intelligence Network: Dirty Lab Artist Residencies in Biocomputing (2027) (closes 4 Dec)
item.description:
European Hybrid Intelligence Network (Kersnikova, ZKM, Kontejner, LABoral, CPN, GLUON), co-funded by Creative Europe
Deadline: 4 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 25,000 fixed residency grant per artist (6 artists), covering fee (max 35%) and production; travel and accommodation arranged separately with the host; optional extra co-production budget in Phase 2. No application fee.

EHIN invites artists to explore hybrid intelligence through the shared agency of the more-than-human world: biocomputing, interspecies and multi-species communication, biofabrication, sensing and biohybrid systems, building new artistic narratives rooted in ecological knowledge.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat New Agents 2027: collective curatorial program (USD 6,000 stipend, Arab world) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Mophradat
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: USD 6,000 stipend per participant, to use at their discretion, paid 2,500 / 2,500 / 1,000. Mophradat also covers retreat travel and a budget for the public event. Number of participants not stated (a small group). No application fee stated.

New Agents brings a small group of art practitioners (artists, curators and researchers) together for ten months to co-develop and realise a public event, such as a conference, festival or exhibition, that foregrounds the collective curatorial experience rather than the participants' individual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.description:
IN SITU (European platform for artistic creation in public space, led by Lieux Publics; Creative Europe)

Award: EUR 1,500 writing aid fee (taxes included) for the immersive lab, plus air travel up to EUR 300 round trip, accommodation and meals. About 10 selected projects later receive IN SITU production residencies. No application fee.

Open Call #3 of IN SITU PLATFORM 2025-2028, the Creative Europe-funded network of 27 programmers supporting artistic creation in public space, for emerging artists with a project in development (beyond the idea stage, not yet premiered or toured) intended for public space or non-conventional...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie: Open Call Cultural Education and Digital Technology 2026 (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie (with LKCA and DEN)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET

Open call (Open Oproep Cultuureducatie en Digitale Technologie) for cultural education projects in which children and young people work creatively with digital technology. Run by the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie with LKCA and DEN.

item.description:
2200
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: CHF 500 monthly stipend (about CHF 1,500 for a three-month stay), plus a studio and accommodation. Travel support negotiable. No application fee stated.

Residency giving emerging artists time and space away from their usual routine. Residents live and work on site in Switzerland for about three months on a project that grows out of the place.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat x BUDA: Performance Residency with a Premiere at NEXT Festival (Kortrijk, 2027) (closes 4 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Mophradat, with BUDA Kortrijk and NEXT Festival
Deadline: 4 Jan 2027, 22:00 UTC
Award: EUR 10,000 all-inclusive, covering travel and visa costs, residency per diems, coproduction costs and a presentation fee for the NEXT Festival performance. Accommodation provided. Compensation if the project cannot travel due to visa refusal. No application fee.

Part of Mophradat's Art Time residencies: a three-week residency at BUDA in Kortrijk, Belgium, for a performing artist from the Arab world finalising a new production, culminating in its premiere at NEXT Festival.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Berlin Senate Work and Research Stipends 2027: Early Music, New Music and Sound Art (Klangkunst) (closes 12 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion, Berlin
Deadline: 12 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET
Award: EUR 12,000 work stipend or EUR 8,000 research stipend (number of awards not stated).

The Berlin Senate's annual stipends for professional musicians and sound artists living in Berlin, here in the early music, new music and sound art (Klangkunst) strand: a EUR 12,000 work stipend or a EUR 8,000 research stipend.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Stiftung Kunstfonds: KUNSTFONDS_Stipendium 2027 (EUR 18,000 for 6 months, Germany-based visual artists) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Stiftung Kunstfonds
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 18,000 over 6 months. No application fee.

Working grant for professional freelance visual artists, media artists included, to concentrate on their practice for six months. The call opened 1 November 2026.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Caza d'Oro Residency for Visual Artists (Le Mas d'Azil, France, rolling)
item.description:
Caza d'Oro, Centre International d'Art Contemporain
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: EUR 1,200 per month residency grant (EUR 3,600 over three months), plus a production budget of EUR 1,800 (Caza d'Oro's own site; the Arts en Résidence network lists EUR 2,000), housing, studio, outreach support and an end-of-residency exhibition. Travel costs are not mentioned.

Caza d'Oro is an international contemporary art centre and residency in Le Mas d'Azil, Ariège, that invites artists to research and make work in the area, with public activities, outreach and an exhibition of the work made during the stay.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

No application fee mentioned.

No application fee.

item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.description: Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden (TUD Dresden University of Technology and The Schaufler Foundation) · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · Fellowship of EUR 3,000 net per month for six months (EUR 18,000), plus a production grant of up to EUR 10,000 for a solo exhibition at the TUD University Gallery in autumn 2027, a studio on campus and help finding accommodation. No application fee.

item.title: Athens Digital Arts Festival 2027 (23rd edition): Open Call "It's Alive..."
item.description: Athens Digital Arts Festival (ADAF) · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). No entry fee. Postal submission costs and artwork transport are at the artist's expense unless agreed otherwise.

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: workspacebrussels Studio Residencies, August to December 2027
item.description: workspacebrussels · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · EUR 750 flat fee per selected project for travel and lunch costs, plus a free studio for one to two weeks, basic technical equipment in some studios, communal lunches and optional work sharings. No application fee.

item.title: IKSV Ortaklasa: EU-Turkiye Cultural Partnership Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) with Culture Action Europe, funded by the European Commission · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · EUR 60,000 to 120,000 per project (total budget EUR 890,000); grants cover 70 to 95 percent of eligible costs, with a minimum 5 percent cash co-financing. Project duration 9 to 12 months.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: Ars Gratia Artis World Film Festival 2027 (Arboga, Sweden)
item.description: Dorobantu Film & Television · deadline 19 Apr 2027 · Great Ars Award for Best Film: SEK 4,000 plus a physical trophy; Best Feature Film and Best Short Film: SEK 2,000 plus an official diploma each. All cash prizes are split equally between director and producer and paid within six months after the festival. Submission fees apply: USD 5 to 18 depending on category and deadline tier.

item.title: Culture Moves Europe: Call for Individual Mobility 2026-2027
item.description: Creative Europe (Culture Moves Europe), implemented by the Goethe-Institut · deadline 30 Apr 2027 · EUR 85 per day of project implementation, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups where applicable: green mobility EUR 400, overseas countries and territories / outermost regions EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18, visa EUR 120. Accessibility support: EUR 30 per day plus actual cost or fixed allowance for personal assistance or sign language interpretation. No application fee.

item.title: Schlossmediale Call for Art Residency 2027 (Schloss Werdenberg, Switzerland)
item.description: Schlossmediale Werdenberg · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CHF 4,000 grant per resident, plus CHF 1,000 for travel, transport and meals, up to CHF 1,000 for material costs, and accommodation in a shared house (individual rooms). Three residencies awarded.

item.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency, 7th Call (Paris)
item.description: Art Explora Foundation and Cité internationale des arts · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month living stipend plus up to EUR 3,000 production grant, a furnished live-work studio of around 50 m2 at the Cité internationale des arts, round-trip travel to Paris and curatorial mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.

item.title: Region Ile-de-France: Programme regional de residences d'artistes (arts plastiques, numeriques et urbains), March 2027 session
item.description: Region Ile-de-France · deadline 18 Mar 2027 · EUR 2,400 gross per month bourse to the artist for a residency of 2 to 10 months; the programme also funds the host venue's mediation programme. No application fee.

item.title: La Scam: Bourses Brouillon d'un reve Sonore (Radio and Podcast Authors, rolling)
item.description: La Scam (Societe civile des auteurs multimedia) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 2,500 to EUR 6,000 per bourse, paid directly to the author 4 to 5 weeks after contract signing; over EUR 830,000 is distributed annually across all Brouillon d'un reve categories. No application fee.
